description: Free-plan Cloudflare protection in front of catchdates.com. Search engines and link previews stay welcome; scripted bulk reading of organizer and event pages is challenged or slowed. Rules this tool owns start with the managed prefix; anything else in the zone is left alone.

http_request_firewall_custom.description: catch-edge: challenge scripted clients on organizer and event pages
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/organizers/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/events/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/explore")) and not cf.client.bot and (http.user_agent eq "" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "python" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scrapy" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "curl" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "wget" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "go-http-client" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "headlesschrome" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "phantomjs" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "httpclient" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "axios" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "node-fetch")

http_ratelimit.description: catch-edge: slow bulk reading of organizer and event pages
http_ratelimit.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/organizers/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/events/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/og/")
